newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal Telecom up on foreign interest.
newsitem.headline: Portugal Telecom up on foreign interest.

text.p: Foreign interest was pushing Portugal Telecom higher in heavy trade on Tuesday and traders saw more upside for the stock.
Telecom was trading at 4,075 escudos ($26.6), up 1.5 percent, in turnover of nearly 800,000 shares.
"There are buy orders for PT from foreigners who know the sector well and could drive the stock up to 4,100 escudos and above," said one trader.

Trader said that the interest stemmed from the good outlook for the company and that fact that big investors had now secured all the stock they wanted in the coming privatisation of Deutsche Telekom and were casting around for other opportunities in the sector.
"The big players have already booked what they want in Deutsche Telekom and are looking around for other (telecommunications) groups," said one trader.
The proposed mega-merger between British Telecom and MCI-Comunications was also galvanising interest in the sector worldwide, traders said.
